description.value: Starbucks at 20151 Fraser Highway is a chain coffee shop located along a major road corridor in the Fraser Valley. It offers espresso drinks, teas, refreshers, and a selection of food items with both in-store and takeout ordering. For touring cyclists passing through the Lower Mainland, it is a recognizable and accessible stop along the Fraser Highway.

OSM tags confirm takeout (takeaway=yes) and Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan), but per the rules OSM amenity tags require website corroboration; takeout is supported by the website's 'Order and Pickup' references, while Wi-Fi cannot be confirmed from website content alone. All cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are unknown as neither the website nor OSM tags address them.
